universe: accepted current ordinary-equity universe filtered by listing/history start at each decision
primary_metric: equal-weight mean sector-date Spearman Rank IC
feature_policy: price observations dated on or before each decision only
training_policy: expanding; labels admitted only after their complete sector-date endpoint is strictly before prediction date
selection_policy: select the two highest positive validation mean-Rank-IC challengers and average their within-sector percentiles; locked-test results cannot change selection
promotion_boundary: current-survivor membership and current sector labels make this supplementary; production promotion requires prospective or true point-in-time universe confirmation
